usedFor: Shopify processes sales and Microsoft Sharepoint keeps the records, so “Order Paid” can feed “Create a List Item”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Paid” in Shopify, then “Create a List Item” in Microsoft Sharepoint
bestTemplate.why: Each paid order becomes a row in a Sharepoint list that your team can sort.

watchOut: “Create a List Item” needs a list to add to, so run “Create a list” once, not per order.
